skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the knowledge about estimating behavior functions, parameters, coefficients in microeconomic models.
Represent market equilibrium models with closed supply and demand in the economy.
Analyze equilibrium in cases of perfect competition, monopoly, and imperfect competition markets.
Represent macroeconomic equilibrium models in closed economies and the role of fiscal and monetary policies.
Understand the IS-LM model on goods-services market and money market equilibrium.
Understand the Mundell-Fleming model for open economy macroeconomic equilibrium.
Apply mathematical skills to estimate behavior functions, parameters, coefficients in microeconomic models.
Determine the equilibrium state of goods-services markets, money markets, foreign exchange markets.
Analyze the impact of fiscal and monetary policies on the equilibrium state of markets in closed economies.
Model and analyze general equilibrium, Walras equilibrium, Pareto equilibrium in economics.
Be proactive in learning and research.
Proactively choose and solve economic problems using modeling methods.
